import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_79/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_79/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_79/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_79/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_79/training_4.csv"
]

# Read all source tables into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all source DataFrames
union_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Ensure the schema and types match the target schema:
# Target Schema: ['hero': string, 'disadvantage': float, 'winrate': float, 'matches': integer]

# Convert columns to correct types explicitly
union_df['hero'] = union_df['hero'].astype(str)
union_df['disadvantage'] = union_df['disadvantage'].astype(float)
union_df['winrate'] = union_df['winrate'].astype(float)
union_df['matches'] = union_df['matches'].astype(int)

# Write the result to the target path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length4_79/target_multisource.csv"
union_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
